title: Jungle Jackpot
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished "Jungle Jackpot" key-art image, wide 2:1 landscape, opaque.
Scene/backdrop: lush emerald and forest-green rainforest clearing with sunlit gold haze, vines, broad glossy leaves, scarlet tropical flowers, a distant waterfall and overgrown stone-and-gold temple with small rounded gold domes/spires and a broad stairway. Preserve the existing fantasy temple identity; no Mayan/Aztec pyramid, deity, new sacred iconography or unrelated cultural motifs.
Subject: one magnificent golden spotted jaguar with turquoise eyes, crouched alertly on a mossy stone ledge, natural feline anatomy and long curling tail. Detailed rosette coat, focused face and elegant paws. Professional painted illustration, no human explorer or extra animals.
Composition/framing: spacious WIDE 2:1. Compact complete jaguar group on the LEFT (x15–45%, y25–79%), large two-line title on the RIGHT (x49–86%, y28–67%), quiet dark green foliage behind the words. Complete main animal and all letters strictly inside central80% width/70% height, generous margins. Jaguar should occupy about HALF the image height, never fill whole canvas. Temple secondary in hazy distance.
Style/medium: luxurious original fantasy game key art, lush painterly materials, restrained warm sunbeams and rim light, coherent premium collection. No crude clipart or excessive glow.
Text (verbatim): "Jungle Jackpot". Exactly these words once on two lines, large warm cream-gold adventure serif lettering with refined dimensional gold edges, extremely legible at 256x128.
Constraints: no other copy, no payouts or extra slogans, no reels, spin buttons, fake interface, logo/watermark, no piles of money. One image only.
editPrompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, Jungle Jackpot title card.
Change ONLY crop-safe spacing: reduce the jaguar (including complete tail and paws) AND exact two-line title "Jungle Jackpot" together to 80% of current sizes, preserving relative left/right arrangement and centering the group. Entire main jaguar and every title letter must fit x12–88%, y17–83%. Repaint exposed areas as matching leaves, mossy ledge and rainforest mist. Keep turquoise eyes, spotted golden coat, gold title style, temple domes/stairway, waterfalls, flowers, lighting and palette unchanged. No new subjects, extra writing, symbols or UI. Preserve wide 2:1 opaque canvas.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected final master and 768x384 WebP. Exact Jungle Jackpot title; golden rosette jaguar with turquoise eyes, lush emerald foliage, flowers, waterfalls and existing domed temple identity. No unrelated iconography, extra copy, UI or payout claims.
visualCheck.thumbnail256x128: Inspected 256x128. Both title words and spotted jaguar read clearly.
visualCheck.crop: Targeted edit puts complete jaguar/tail and title within central80% width/70% height. Secondary temple and foliage extend toward edges.
